Mr A. S. Agrawal, Advocate for the Applicants.
Ms M. H. Deshmukh, Addl. P. P. for the Non-Applicant No.1/State.
Coram : Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.
Date : 15th February, 2023.

. Heard.
2.

This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report (Fir) in Crime No.115 of
2021, registered with Wadgaon (Jangal) Police Station, for the offence punishable under Sections
498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, alongwith related
criminal case bearing Rcc No.1562 of 2021, pending on the file of Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Yavatmal.
3. The Applicants are husband and in-laws of informant lady.
It is contended that the allegations levelled in the report are vague.
Particularly, it is submitted that one day prior to the registration of FIR, informant has given a report to Ajni Police, wherein she has not ventilated the grievance which was put on the next day.
Thus, according to the Applicants, the allegations are false.
4. Issue notice for final disposal to the Non-Applicants, returnable after four weeks.

Learned Additional Public 12 APL-228-2023 Prosecutor waives notice on behalf of Non-Applicant No.1/State.
5.
In the meantime, the Trial Court shall not insist for the presence of Applicant Nos.1 and 2 in the Ramdas S/O Harbaji Bhatarkar And 2 ... vs The State Of Mha.
